original_requirement: Two independent offline hosts must contend for one shared physical actuator. With no communication, no shared storage and no preallocated exclusive owner, either host may acquire it when alone, but simultaneous requests must allow exactly one grant and exactly one physical activation. Rejections are BUSY, no rejected request may activate the actuator, and committed grants survive both hosts restarting. Grant authority must be established by the execution system, not a supplied actor string.
